name: opencode-bridge
description: Chat client for OpenCode (opencode.ai). Connects to a local `opencode serve` HTTP server; does not call any LLM API itself.

commands.title: OpenCode: Add current file as context

opencodeBridge.port.description: Port the local `opencode serve` HTTP server listens on.

opencodeBridge.hostname.description: Hostname of the local `opencode serve` HTTP server.

opencodeBridge.autoStartServer.description: Legacy setting kept for compatibility. Managed mode always starts its own private server; external mode only connects to an existing one.

opencodeBridge.opencodePath.description: Path or name of the `opencode` binary (must be in PATH unless an absolute path is given).

opencodeBridge.model.description: Optional model as providerID/modelID (e.g. anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022). If empty, OpenCode's own default model is used.

opencodeBridge.debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to the 'OpenCode Bridge' Output channel and console.

opencodeBridge.responseTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds without any server event before the chat shows a non-blocking "Still waiting" message with a Cancel button. Slow or local models may need a larger value.

opencodeBridge.serverMode.description: Server connection mode. 'managed' (default) starts a private opencode serve instance with a random password. 'external' connects to an existing server at hostname:port.

opencodeBridge.permissions.description: How tool permission requests are handled. 'ask' (default) shows an Allow once / Allow always / Reject card for every request. 'readOnlyAuto' automatically answers read-only requests with 'once'; edits, writes, and shell commands are still always shown. 'always' is never chosen automatically.

opencodeBridge.autoStopRepetition.description: Automatically stop generation when the model falls into a degenerate repetition loop (one character or a short pattern repeated hundreds of times). When false (default), a warning banner lets you Stop, switch models, or dismiss.

opencodeBridge.maxAttachmentBytes.description: Largest file (in bytes) that can be attached to a prompt. Files above this are refused before the prompt is sent; files above ~1 MB are attached with a warning.

enumDescriptions: Each paragraph picks its own direction (best for Persian/Arabic mixed with English).
opencodeBridge.ui.textDirection.description: Text direction of chat messages. 'auto' aligns Persian/Arabic/Hebrew paragraphs to the right and English to the left.

opencodeBridge.ui.fontFamily.description: Font for the chat. Empty uses the editor's UI font. Example for Persian: Vazirmatn, Tahoma, sans-serif. Only letters, digits, spaces, commas, dots, quotes and dashes are accepted.

opencodeBridge.ui.fontSize.description: Chat font size in pixels (8-32). 0 uses the editor's font size.

opencodeBridge.ui.modelLabelMaxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels of the model name in the composer toolbar before it is cut with an ellipsis. Raise it if long names like 'NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL' are truncated.

opencodeBridge.ui.showToolControls.description: Show Stop and 'Run in background' buttons on a running tool call (for example a shell command) so it can be controlled without scrolling to the composer.
